title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode3 A Reliable Friend

meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhumm♪
I'm the first one here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Lemme get my sketchbook and pens out and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Get started on Operation: Exciting Weed Pulling Poster☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My poster's gonna make pulling weeds look like so much fun that everyone's going to come join us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll have it say, “Fun volunteer opportunity! Come pull weeds with us!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where should I write the date...?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
The posters for our shows always put that towards the bottom!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, I'll put the date somewhere around there, and have a picture of people pulling weeds in the middle!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhummｍ♪
Pulling weeds with everyone is so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, you are here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, Honami☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Good morning.
I just happened to hear your voice while working on some things for the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? What are you drawing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, this?!
Check it out! Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Fun volunteer opportunity! Come pull weeds with us!”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
I've been asked to volunteer to pull weeds as a class rep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I was just working on a poster that's going to get more people to join us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
These people pulling weeds have such lovely smiles on their faces.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This should help convince others that pulling weeds can be very fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You think so? Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I bet this poster would become even more wonderhoy if you drew something, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really love the way you draw because they're such a great expression of your feelings! They always look sparkly and fluffy and fuzzy and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I always love looking at them because they're so explosively eye-opening, like kapow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I-I'm not sure if that counts as praise...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu...
Then, why don't I draw a little picture in this corner?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How does this look...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's really cute!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is that a butterfly?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's supposed to be a flower.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I thought that more flowers will be able to bloom once all the weeds have been pulled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, now I see!
These little stick thingies must be the stamens, and the white flappy parts are the petals!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I apologize if it was hard to tell.
Anyway, I should get going...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, wait!
Can you draw more flowers for me?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I feel like that'll make this poster cuter and more fun!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, I'll draw a few more.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. Thanks to Honami, this poster's gonna look super wonderhoy!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I can't wait to show it to Asahina!)
A few days later
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I'll use these chopsticks.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Umm... I've served everyone a bowl of rice, so I think we're ready to eat.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Honami & Kanade
rows.Line: Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for having me over again today. And for allowing me to join you for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My grandmother sent over a big box of vegetables, but they won't stay fresh for long. So, I'm glad you're here to help us get through them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm also glad.
But please feel free to have as much as you like, you two. These braised eggplants turned out even better than they did last time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You've looked really tired lately, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It has been very hot this summer.
If you like, I can make something that's easier on the stomach.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I was just thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've been asked to run a volunteer weeding program as part of my class representative duties, but we've been having trouble recruiting people...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Weeding...?
Will you be doing that with Emu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, how did you know...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I just happened to come across Emu drawing a poster for it the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Recruiting people for that sounds really hard...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It is.
Especially since it's been so hot this year. No one seems interested.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which is why I was thinking about other ways to get the word out.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I was just working on a poster that's going to get more people to join us!
The next day
Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hmm... I just checked the sign-up sheet, but it seems there haven't been any new volunteers.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... What can we do to make it so people want to come join us...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Well...
Our remaining options are...
Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, Asahina, do you two have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Honami? Is something the matter?
Are you here to do cleanup committee stuff?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No.
So...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If you're both okay with it, I'd like to volunteer to help pull weeds.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
You'll come pull weeds with us?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I helped a little with running this event? I feel like I want to lend you two a hand after seeing you putting in so much effort.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-Honami!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mochizuki.
Then, I think we'll gladly accept your kind offer.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I take it no one else has signed up to help?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
As far as volunteer work goes, it appears that this seems the most taxing in everyone's minds.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
It does involve manual labor...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... But I still think working together to make everything look pretty is gonna be a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fun...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
What if we tried a new angle?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A new angle...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. For example, if all participants are promised a delicious meal, then they'll know that their hard work will be rewarded in the end.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's really good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, but you'll have budget constraints to think about, so I'm sure we can't do anything lavish like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I agree.
That is a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We should be upfront about how tough this is going to be, but also show that it can be very fun and rewarding. That should help convince people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tough, but also fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(But how do we make this fun?
What would convince people to come pull weeds with us...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (How do we get the attention of all the school students, elderly residents and small children...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know!
Asahina! Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should take this opportunity to go there for ourselves and investigate!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu & Honami
rows.Line: Investigate...?
